name: FPP Pushover Notifications
author: Juan Melendrez
description: Detects FPP playlist events and sends configurable notifications through Pushover.

privacy.summary: The current test build records playlist-start and media-change events locally, including media title and artist. Once notifications are enabled, configured event details will be sent to Pushover over HTTPS.

collects.what: Local playlist and media event log

privacy.other: The current build does not send requests to Pushover and does not store Pushover credentials.
